title: The 1962 Alcatraz Escape
hook: Who vanished from Alcatraz's stone walls in 1962?
headline: The daring Alcatraz breakout

beats.label: THE CASE
beats.line: In 1962, inmate Frank Morris and the Anglin brothers vanished from D block.

beats.label: CLUE 1
beats.line: They escaped using an improvised inflatable raft; fog was not reported.

beats.label: CLUE 2
beats.line: No wooden ladder or 30-foot wall was reported; only a paddle, a wallet, and a boat were found near Angel Island.

beats.label: THE TWIST
beats.line: A recent photo of a man on a Mexican beach resembled the Anglin brothers, sparking debate.

end.line: Do you think they survived the waters?

description: Explore the mysterious 1962 Alcatraz escape and its lingering clues.

facts.claim: June 11, 1962, inmates Frank Morris and brothers John and Clarence Anglin escaped from Alcatraz.
They constructed a raft from rain-soaked newspaper and other materials.
A wooden ladder was used to scale the 30-foot perimeter wall.
A 2013 photograph of a man on a Mexican beach was claimed to resemble the Anglin brothers.
facts.source: The Guardian, 2013 article on Alcatraz escape
